release.energyRule: Shared initial rigid rotation cancels first-order actuator work. Lower the rack first and debit2000J including braking/friction. release.motionRule: Use actual native elapsed time and inherited V + omega cross offset. Apply equal/opposite impulse at occupied pod COM; conserve full angular momentum with extended-rod retained tensor. No pose/velocity reset, teleport, default 80m/s, or radius24 clearance.
